description: Search scholarly papers (OpenAlex index of 250M+ works). Returns up to 25 results with title, authors, year, venue, DOI, citation count, open-access PDF link, abstract (reconstructed from OpenAlex's inverted index; may be null when the publisher withholds it) and OpenAlex id. Optional from_year / to_year / open_access_only filters. Data: OpenAlex (CC0, openalex.org) with Crossref REST (crossref.org) for retraction notices and as fallback. Upstream errors are not charged. Costs $0.005 USDC per search via x402.

query.description: Search terms (title, abstract and full-text relevance search)

name: search_papers
